pairs.title: A more editorial voice
pairs.rationale: Fraunces brings an editorial, hospitality feel. Inter keeps the message direct and familiar.

pairs.title: A softer kind of confidence
pairs.rationale: Manrope adds warmth through its rounder letterforms without turning the content casual.

pairs.title: A little more digital
pairs.rationale: Space Grotesk gives the question a game-interface character; body type and spacing stay fixed.

pairs.title: How loud should the headline be?
pairs.rationale: A denser display face adds poster energy. The words, scale, color and composition stay the same.

pairs.title: Cool clarity or warm paper?
pairs.rationale: Warm neutrals and a sparing brass accent suggest print and hospitality. The layout stays identical.

pairs.title: Light canvas or deep forest?
pairs.rationale: A deep green field gives the photograph a richer setting. The same image, type and crop remain.

pairs.title: Daylight or after dark?
pairs.rationale: A dark violet surface and lime accents create digital energy without adding extra decoration.

pairs.title: Classic green or playful cobalt?
pairs.rationale: Cobalt makes the poster more expressive; coral carries the supporting panel. Type and placement stay fixed.

pairs.title: A warmer welcome
pairs.rationale: A warm email treatment feels more like a hospitality note. The reading order and button remain unchanged.

pairs.title: What should lead: words or people?
pairs.rationale: The image moves above the headline. This tests whether the social moment or the message should get the first glance.

pairs.title: Editorial edge or centered statement?
pairs.rationale: A centered axis gives a short poster a more ceremonial feel. A left edge feels conversational and easy to scan.

pairs.title: A card or an open letter?
pairs.rationale: Removing the outer card creates an open letter on the same canvas. The internal content and spacing stay fixed.

pairs.title: Rows or columns?
pairs.rationale: An equal three-column layout gives all figures the same rank. The stacked version emphasizes the total.

pairs.title: Straight frame or architectural arch?
pairs.rationale: An arch adds a hospitality cue while keeping the image, crop and placement fixed.

pairs.title: Framed or edge to edge?
pairs.rationale: Taking the photograph to the edge makes the scene more immersive. Text keeps its original margins.

pairs.title: More place or more expression?
pairs.rationale: A closer crop gives faces more presence. The wider view gives the casino lounge more context.

pairs.title: In the venue or in everyday life?
pairs.rationale: Two adult social scenes test the relevance of a casino setting against a more everyday moment. Frame and message stay fixed.

pairs.title: Panels or a quiet ledger?
pairs.rationale: An unboxed ledger feels more editorial. Filled panels make the groups easier to distinguish at a glance.

pairs.title: Which number gets the spotlight?
pairs.rationale: A larger total makes the return the first thing you see. The stake and profit stay clearly labeled.

pairs.title: Technical or conversational numbers?
pairs.rationale: Source Code Pro feels precise; Inter brings the data closer to the rest of the voice. Values and size stay fixed.

pairs.title: A little softer around the edges
pairs.rationale: Large corners make answer cards feel more approachable. Color, spacing and labels are unchanged.

pairs.title: A sharper edge
pairs.rationale: Square geometry brings a more editorial discipline. The card border and content stay fixed.

pairs.title: Flat or tactile?
pairs.rationale: A small hard shadow gives the cards a tactile game-piece quality without gradients or gloss.

pairs.title: Soft geometry or cut corners?
pairs.rationale: Cut corners introduce a digital visual cue. The content and visual hierarchy remain the same.

pairs.title: How much emphasis should an action carry?
pairs.rationale: A filled action is more prominent. An outline keeps the email quieter while preserving the same target size.

pairs.title: A button with a softer silhouette
pairs.rationale: A pill adds a more social, welcoming cue. Size, color and wording stay fixed.

pairs.title: Product action or editorial invitation?
pairs.rationale: A text action makes the message read like an editorial note. The filled button gives the next step more presence.

pairs.title: Warmth without added noise
pairs.rationale: A cream surface and forest accent add warmth. Contact order, language and contrast remain clear.

pairs.title: Does support need a container?
pairs.rationale: Removing the filled panel makes the contact feel integrated into the page. The same button and wording remain.

pairs.title: Reassurance first or contact first?
pairs.rationale: Moving the contact up makes it available earlier. Both versions keep the same warm, direct language.

pairs.title: A quiet editorial signature
pairs.headline:
Even a good night
has an end time.
pairs.copy:
Choose when to wrap up before you play.
A reminder can help you keep track.
pairs.rationale: A fine editorial line brings the contact details into the reading flow. The photograph gains room and the age notice remains distinct.
pairs.scope: Layout study · US contact and age preview
pairs.assumption: The same contact information and age notice appear in both versions. Placement and composition change. This is not a cleared state-specific advertisement.

pairs.title: Give the information its own margin
pairs.headline:
Your night.
Your number.
pairs.copy:
Choose what you’re happy to spend
before the night gets going.
pairs.rationale: A broad side note makes the information part of the page architecture. The headline and budget card reflow alongside it; nothing is hidden or rotated.
pairs.scope: Layout study · US contact and age preview
pairs.assumption: The same contact information and age notice appear in both versions. Placement and composition change. This is not a cleared state-specific advertisement.

pairs.title: An action with support beside it
pairs.headline:
Make time
for the rest.
pairs.copy:
Set a reminder before you play.
Give yourself a moment to check in.
pairs.rationale: A cream action card pairs the invitation with a quiet support line. Rounded photography and a generous green field keep the hospitality character.
pairs.scope: Layout study · US contact and age preview
pairs.assumption: The same contact information and age notice appear in both versions. Placement and composition change. This is not a cleared state-specific advertisement.

pairs.title: Playful page. Straightforward information.
pairs.headline:
Your budget.
Your call.
pairs.copy:
Include gambling in your entertainment budget.
Choose a limit before you play.
pairs.rationale: Bold colour and a tactile planning card carry the playful energy. Contact information sits on a flat, readable note with no game motifs or novelty lettering.
pairs.scope: Layout study · US contact and age preview
pairs.assumption: The same contact information and age notice appear in both versions. Placement and composition change. This is not a cleared state-specific advertisement.

pairs.title: Let the contact lead
pairs.headline:
Here if
you need it.
pairs.copy: You can ask a question about gambling before deciding what to do next.
pairs.rationale: The phone number moves ahead of the explanation. A light lilac surface, plain language and an obvious action give an adult digital brand a calmer support voice.
pairs.assumption: Calm support-screen study. Both versions retain the same phone number, contact label and action. No gambling imagery or playful support treatment.

pairs.title: A little more like a personal note
pairs.headline:
Start with
a question.
pairs.copy: You can talk about gambling without deciding what to do next.
pairs.rationale: Warm paper and a single reading edge make support feel like an invitation. Removing the contact box preserves the number, its label and the same action.
pairs.assumption: Calm support-screen study. Both versions retain the same phone number, contact label and action. No gambling imagery or playful support treatment.

pairs.title: Give a small banner room to breathe
pairs.assumption: The same information moves from the banner into the illustrated destination. IGRG paragraph 46 permits format-specific treatment of online banners; this is not an exception for all social ads. The preview shows a direct support route on the destination.
pairs.rationale: Two connected surfaces are shown together. The banner keeps one short invitation; the destination provides an immediately visible support route. Both views retain the same words. The miniature browser is a static layout specimen.

pairs.title: Build the composition around the message
pairs.headline:
Your budget.
Your call.
pairs.copy:
Decide what you can spend
before you place a bet.
pairs.assumption: Both versions keep the same black-on-white tagline and support CTA. This studies panel placement, not exemption. Operator, state/territory, placement and any additional disclosure requirements still need review.
pairs.rationale: The warning becomes a deliberate white panel within the composition. Its type stays straightforward; the surrounding green and cream design supplies the brand expression.
